external_intelligence.title: GAO-26-104321: Federal Loan Guarantee Programs — Best Practices for Program Design and Implementation

programs_matched.relevance_reason: Direct match: report covers Title XVII loan guarantee design and implementation, the exact statutory basis for LGP
programs_matched.so_what: 4 of 12 GAO best-practice criteria are not currently reflected in LGP's program kit. Specifically: (1) applicant feedback loop after denial, (2) annual portfolio stress test, (3) third-party credit review for transactions >$100M, (4) public reporting on approval timelines. None require additional resources — procedural additions only.
programs_matched.suggested_action: LGP PM review GAO checklist against current program kit by 2026-06-01 and flag gaps for AI Lead

external_intelligence.title: OMB M-26-12: Updated Implementation Guidance for Agency AI Operations

programs_matched.relevance_reason: M-26-12 Section 4.2 covers AI-assisted regulatory review processes applicable to LGP's implementing guidance workflow
programs_matched.so_what: LGP must document its AI-assisted review process in the next annual report. The new memo requires a HITL review log for any AI-generated regulatory text. LGP already has HITL gates but they are not logged in the required format.
programs_matched.suggested_action: GC review M-26-12 Section 4.2 and confirm whether LGP's current HITL logging meets new requirements by 2026-05-28

peer_learnings.learning: Escalated from working-level to Deputy AS two weeks before the commitment due date rather than waiting for the miss. Sent a brief one-pager explaining the delay and proposed revised timeline.
peer_learnings.outcome: Commitment renegotiated with 3-week extension, no adverse effect on program timeline. DOT counterparty appreciated the advance notice.
peer_learnings.similarity_basis: Both programs share DOE as primary inter-agency partner, both in active execution phase with Title XVII authority

peer_learnings.learning: Ran a 30-minute 'pre-application office hours' session weekly starting 8 weeks before portal launch. Invited potential applicants to ask eligibility questions live. Reduced post-launch eligibility Q&A volume by 40%.
peer_learnings.outcome: Portal launched on schedule. First-week application volume 35% higher than projected. GS-12 analyst ran the sessions with no AI support required.
peer_learnings.similarity_basis: Both programs are grant programs in stand-up phase with external applicant-facing components

best_practices.title: Pre-application office hours — weekly 30-min sessions starting 8 weeks before portal launch
best_practices.practice_description: Run weekly 30-minute open Q&A sessions for potential applicants beginning 8 weeks before portal launch. Hosted by one GS-12 analyst. No preparation required — answer eligibility questions live and log the questions to improve FAQs.
best_practices.outcome_evidence: Reduced post-launch eligibility Q&A volume 40%. First-week application volume 35% above projection. Zero added FTE.

best_practices.title: Structured comment triage taxonomy — rulemaking dockets >200 comments
best_practices.practice_description: Apply a 6-category taxonomy to public comments before substantive review: (1) Duplicative, (2) Out-of-scope, (3) Procedural, (4) Technical/factual, (5) Policy, (6) Requires external expert. Categories 1-3 handled by GS-11 analyst with Haiku assist. Categories 4-6 routed to subject matter expert.
best_practices.outcome_evidence: Cut comment review time 55% on a 450-comment docket. Expert reviewer time freed from 80% routine to 20% routine.

system_prompt_constraints.group_head: You have access to portfolio-level synthesis for the full program portfolio. You do NOT have access to individual program action items, program-level operational detail, or peer learning cards. If asked for that level of detail, direct the user to the relevant DR or program manager.
system_prompt_constraints.dr: You have access to exception-level summaries for programs in your span. You do NOT have access to individual staff-level task assignments or program-internal operational detail not yet escalated to you. If asked, direct the user to the program manager.
system_prompt_constraints.program_manager: You have access to full operational detail for your program(s). You do NOT have access to other programs' raw operational detail — only curated peer learning cards are surfaced from adjacent programs.
system_prompt_constraints.staff: You have access to your own program's action queue and capture surface. You do NOT have access to the dashboard or other programs.
